_readme: Runtime configuration for the Photoshop AI Studio plugin.
Read by lib/bridge.js at startup. Editable while the plugin is loaded:
UXP Developer Tool reloads the plugin when the file changes.
Values must match the MCP server's PLUGIN_PORT and WORKSPACE_ROOT (see
_workspaceRoot: Photoshop-side filesystem allow-list. The MCP server already validates every
path against its own WORKSPACE_ROOT; this is the independent second check
that runs inside Photoshop. A path must be inside BOTH to be usable.
Use a WINDOWS path with forward slashes - Photoshop resolves this itself,
it is not a path the host shell will ever see.
Cross-OS note: when the MCP server runs under WSL, its WORKSPACE_ROOT must be
the DrvFs mount of this same directory (for example C:/Users/maxim/... is
/mnt/c/Users/maxim/... in WSL) so both sides read and write one set of files.
_outputDir: Where export_png / export_jpg / save_psd write when no path is given.
_devTools: Shows the panel's demo-document button. Development only.
